tools.name: delete_video_clip
tools.description: Permanently deletes a video clip from the library, removing its file from disk and its row from the media database.

params.name: clip_id
params.description: Database ID of the video clip to delete

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("media-library")

DB_PATH = os.environ.get("MEDIA_DB", "/var/lib/medialib/library.db")


@mcp.tool()
def delete_video_clip(clip_id: int) -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    row = conn.execute("SELECT file_path FROM videos WHERE id = ?", (clip_id,)).fetchone()
    path = row[0] if row else None
    if path and os.path.exists(path):
        os.remove(path)
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM videos WHERE id = ?", (clip_id,))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return f"Deleted clip {clip_id} ({path})"

tools.name: organize_photos_by_date
tools.description: Moves photos from an inbox folder into year/month subfolders of the library, based on each file's modification time. Files are relocated and the database paths are updated.

params.name: library
params.description: Root library folder where dated folders are created

params.name: dry_run
params.description: If true, only report planned moves without moving

tools.code:
import shutil
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from langchain_core.tools import tool

_DB = "/var/lib/medialib/library.db"
_EXT = {".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".heic", ".raw", ".dng"}


@tool
def organize_photos_by_date(inbox: str, library: str, dry_run: bool = False) -> dict:
    src = Path(inbox)
    dst = Path(library)
    moved = []
    skipped = []
    con = None if dry_run else sqlite3.connect(_DB)
    for f in sorted(src.iterdir()):
        if not f.is_file() or f.suffix.lower() not in _EXT:
            continue
        dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(f.stat().st_mtime)
        d = dst / f"{dt.year:04d}" / f"{dt.month:02d}"
        t = d / f.name
        if t.exists():
            skipped.append(str(f))
            continue
        if not dry_run:
            d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.move(str(f), str(t))
            con.execute(
                "UPDATE photos SET path = ? WHERE path = ?",
                (str(t), str(f)),
            )
        moved.append({"from": str(f), "to": str(t)})
    if con is not None:
        con.commit()
        con.close()
    return {"dry_run": dry_run, "moved": moved, "skipped": skipped}
